`requirements.md` has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-103201-bugfix-dark-eyedropper/requirements.md` covering:

- **Reproduce + Diagnose**: Exact reproduction steps with the `#1e1e1e` → `#d3d3d3` → `#383838` hex progression and root-cause diagnosis in `EyeDropper.tsx` (`getCurrentColor`) and `applyDarkModeFilter` (`packages/common/src/colors.ts`).
- **In scope & Out of scope**: Numbered, testable items matching the Gate 0 allowlist, read-only files (`actionProperties.tsx`, `App.bucketFill.ts`, `App.cursor.ts`), and non-goals.
- **Functional & Non-functional requirements**: `FR-1`..`FR-8` and `NFR-1`..`NFR-3` covering `invertDarkModeFilter` in `packages/common/src/colors.ts`, dark-theme conversion in `EyeDropper.tsx`, preview swatch preservation, light-theme preservation, and changelog entry.
- **PII inventory & Role matrix**: Marked as not applicable (client-side colour math).
- **Acceptance criteria & Open questions**: `AC-1`..`AC-7` mirroring the intent brief, including the exact test command `yarn test:typecheck && yarn test:code && yarn test:app --watch=false`, with no remaining open questions.
